scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-listenflow --only auth,firestore,functions "node scripts/integration.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-listenflow --only auth,firestore,functions "playwright test"
scripts.test:standalone: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-listenflow --only auth,firestore "node scripts/test-standalone.mjs"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-listenflow --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.deploy:spark: npm run build && firebase deploy --config firebase.spark.json --only hosting,firestore --project listenflow-english-20261117
scripts.deploy:blaze: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,functions,firestore
